messages:
Priya Rao: Quick note from the weekly check-in: VoltLabs error-rate jumped this morning during their onboarding traffic burst. Putting a short breakdown here so CS + SRE can triage.
cs-bot: [auto] acct=VoltLabs window=08:50-09:20 UTC 5xx=4.0% (+3.2pp) timeouts=1.8% (+1.1pp) rate_limit=1.2% (+0.6pp) spend_delta=+12% top_paths=[/v1/chat/stream, /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings] region=eu-central-1
Ethan Brooks: Thanks. Are errors concentrated by route or model?
Zoe Lin: I pulled recent spans 0 samples show majority 502/504 on /v1/chat/stream; /v1/embeddings returned 429s correlated with token spikes.
Zoe Lin: sample logs:
```
[08:52:10] POST /v1/chat/stream 504 upstream-timeout runtime=rt-17
[08:52:14] POST /v1/generate 502 kernel-failure model=gpt-medium
[08:53:01] POST /v1/embeddings 429 quota-exceeded user=voltlabs-onboard
```
Diego Alvarez: Likely two-layer problem: streaming backlog causing upstream timeouts + embeddings hitting per-minute quotas during parallel batched jobs.
Priya Rao: Immediate mitigations proposed: 1) route VoltLabs streaming to canary fallback model `gpt-rt-small` for 30m; 2) temporary per-account embeddings throttle increase; 3) enable KV prefix caching for repeated embed calls in onboarding job.
Ethan Brooks: I can request quota bump with infra (ticket created: CS-INC-2319). Also will add a temporary routing rule.
Zoe Lin: I'll lower default streaming chunk_size from 8 -> 4 for VoltLabs on the runtime tier to reduce memory pressure, testing in staging now.
Diego Alvarez: Add note to account: onboarding-risk=medium; recommend CS team delay next bulk ingest until metrics stabilize.
Priya Rao: Action list:
- Ethan: follow up on CS-INC-2319 and confirm quota change (owner Ethan)
- Zoe: validate chunk_size change results and post latency/error delta (owner Zoe)
- Diego: update account renewal-risk flag and coordinate with AE (owner Diego)
- Priya: monitor alerts for 2 hours and escalate to eng-oncall if 5xx remains >2% (owner Priya)
Ethan Brooks: I'll ping VoltLabs CSM and schedule a 15m sync.
cs-bot: [update] alert-suppressed for VoltLabs until 09:30 UTC per mitigation; will resume normal thresholds after window.
Priya Rao: Thanks everyone. If you see a new class of 5xx (kernel or OOM), tag #eng-runtime immediately.
Zoe Lin: Will post staging results in ~20m. :hourglass:
